scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "dotnet watch --project server/ComicStrike.Server run -- --no-browser" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.publish: npm run build && dotnet publish server/ComicStrike.Server -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:EnableCompressionInSingleFile=true -p:DebugType=none -o publish
